title: Cross-Sell Lead Scoring and Personalised Outreach
summary: Score existing customers for products they are likely to need from consented banking data, and draft compliant, personalised outreach that relationship managers review before sending.

seo.title: Bank Cross-Sell Lead Scoring and Outreach AI | VipraTech
seo.description: AI that scores retail banking customers for cross-sell, checks consent and DND, and drafts personalised outreach for relationship managers to approve.

problem.intro: Banks hold clear signals about customer needs, such as salary credits, maturing deposits, rent payments and foreign card spends, yet cross-sell often runs on broad campaigns and product targets. Customers receive offers that do not fit them, relationship managers chase cold lists, and every untargeted message adds consent and mis-selling risk.

pain_points.title: Lists built on product targets
pain_points.detail: Campaigns pick customers by simple filters, so a recent home loan borrower receives another home loan offer.

pain_points.title: Relationship managers without context
pain_points.detail: RMs call customers with no clear reason why a product fits, and results depend on individual skill.

pain_points.title: Consent and DND checked too late
pain_points.detail: Opt-outs, DND preferences and the purpose of consent are checked at sending time, if at all, rather than when the list is built.

pain_points.title: Suitability of third-party products
pain_points.detail: Insurance and investment products sold through the bank carry suitability and mis-selling risk that generic scripts ignore.

solution.overview: We build a lead scoring and outreach service on your existing data warehouse. Propensity models score customers for selected products using consented transaction and relationship data, and every score comes with plain-language reasons, such as a fixed deposit maturing next month or regular rent debits. Eligibility, consent, DND and exclusion rules are applied before a customer enters any list. A language model drafts personalised messages for WhatsApp, email or an RM call script in the customer's preferred language, using approved product facts only. RMs see prioritised leads with reasons and drafts, approve or edit each message, and record outcomes that feed model retraining.
capabilities: Product propensity scoring with plain-language reasons per customer
Eligibility, consent, DND and exclusion rules applied before any outreach list is built
Drafts for WhatsApp, email and RM call scripts in English, Hindi and regional languages
Content restricted to approved product facts, rates and disclosures
RM worklist with priority, reasons, drafts and one-click outcome capture
Campaign and outcome analytics feeding scheduled model retraining

workflow.title: Prepare signals
workflow.detail: Consented transaction, product holding and relationship data from the warehouse become customer-level signals.

workflow.title: Score and explain
workflow.detail: Propensity models score each customer for each product, and reason codes explain every score.

workflow.title: Apply eligibility and consent
workflow.detail: Customers failing eligibility, consent, DND or exclusion rules are removed before any list is built.

workflow.title: Draft outreach
workflow.detail: The language model drafts channel-specific messages from approved product content in the customer's preferred language.

workflow.title: RM review and send
workflow.detail: RMs approve, edit or drop each lead and message, and sending goes through approved channels and templates.

workflow.title: Learn from outcomes
workflow.detail: Responses, conversions, opt-outs and complaints feed back into scoring and content reviews.

inputs: Consented transaction and product holding data from the warehouse
Customer consent, DND and channel preferences
Product eligibility rules and exclusion lists
Approved product content, rates and disclosures
Historical campaign outcomes and RM feedback
outputs: Prioritised lead lists with reason codes
Personalised message drafts per channel and language
Exclusion log showing why customers were removed
human_in_the_loop: Relationship managers approve or edit every message before it goes out, and product and compliance teams approve the content library. Leads for third-party products such as insurance and mutual funds go only to staff qualified to discuss them.
integrations: CRM such as Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics or an in-house RM tool
WhatsApp Business API through an approved provider
Email and SMS gateways with DLT-registered templates
guardrails: Consent, DND and exclusion rules applied before results reach any list
Messages use approved content only, with no invented rates, offers or eligibility
Frequency caps per customer across all channels
Sensitive attributes excluded from models, with fairness checks each cycle
No promise of loan approval or investment returns in any draft
compliance_notes: Designed to support DPDP Act 2023 consent and purpose limitation, and TRAI commercial communication rules on DLT registration and customer preferences.
Supports RBI fair-practice expectations on suitability and mis-selling; insurance and investment products also follow their IRDAI and SEBI distribution rules.

pilot.scope: One product, such as fixed deposit renewal or a pre-approved credit card, for customers of a group of branches, with RM-approved outreach compared against the current campaign approach.
deliverables: Propensity model with reason codes for the pilot product
Pilot results compared with a held-out control group
Plan for further products and channels

what_we_measure.how: Outcomes for scored customers compared with a randomly held-out control group over the same period.

what_we_measure.metric: RM acceptance of leads and drafts
what_we_measure.how: Leads RMs pursued, and drafts sent as written, edited or rejected.
Opt-outs and complaints per message, compared with the current campaign baseline.
Predicted propensity bands compared with observed responses.

faqs.q: What data do the models use?
faqs.a: Only data covered by the customer's consent and your privacy notice, typically product holdings, transaction categories and relationship history. Sensitive attributes such as religion or caste are excluded, and we review likely proxies during model development.

faqs.q: Can the AI send messages on its own?
faqs.a: Not in our default design. RMs approve each message, or for routine service reminders marketing approves a template that the system fills. All sending goes through your existing DLT-registered and WhatsApp-approved templates.

faqs.q: Which languages can drafts be written in?
faqs.a: English, Hindi and regional languages, based on the customer's stated preference. Product facts and disclosures come from the approved library in each language, reviewed by your team.

faqs.q: How do we know the scoring works?
faqs.a: The pilot holds back a random control group, so results compare scored outreach with your current approach on the same population and period.
